ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 45 percent high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated on the lateral lobes and 55 percent low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and right-central fluke regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity contiguous region on the left lateral lobe featuring several discrete low-intensity focal spots. A dominant, centrally located low-intensity mass extends through the notch and across the proximal right lobe, transitioning via mottled boundaries into a smaller high-intensity region on the right distal area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 64 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the lobe span of roughly 12 percent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, consistent serration pattern along the left lobe trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes of 10-15 pixels. Right lobe exhibits irregular, high-amplitude jaggedness and structural truncation at the terminal end.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe trailing edge follows a smooth convex parabolic trajectory. The right lobe trajectory is irregular and discontinuous at the distal tip due to pixel-level edge deformation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately six discrete, roughly circular low-intensity clusters (black) localized against the high-intensity background of the white left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel, vertical high-intensity linear disruptions (rake-like features) observed crossing the central low-intensity (black) region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial terminal truncation and jagged deformity at the right distal fluke tip; high-contrast vertical linear abrasions across the central-right pigmented surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark, high-relief cluster of pixels at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, consistent with biological growth or complex traumatic scar tissue.
